reason: The README describes a DSH shell overlay whose primary purpose is to provide a macOS-style desktop layout and themed interface, with integrated workspace files, terminal, documents, browser, knowledge base, and AI tools.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 macOS 风格的桌面布局与主题，并集成工作区文件、终端、文档、浏览器、知识库和 AI 工具。
summaries.en: Adds a macOS-style desktop layout and theme to the DSH web interface with integrated workspace files, terminal, documents, browser, knowledge base, and AI tools.

capabilities: overlays and themes the DSH web interface
reads and writes files within the configured workspace
renders third-party pages in an iframe
uses configured AI conversation, image generation, and image analysis services
